programs.title: Bronze Dogs and Robot Minds: Pet Care Meets AI Governance
outcomes: Explain how the Balto statue and Central Park's lawns connect pets to community memory
Describe what an agent-managed DAO is and why humans make final decisions
Draft a simple class charter with roles reserved for people
Compare pet care rules with AI care rules

sessions.activity: Visit the Balto statue's story; compare 'who takes care of pets' with 'who governs AI' and write a class mission statement with human-only votes.
Use a kid-safe Evidence Monitor demo to collect facts about sled dogs and AI assistants; sort evidence from opinion.
Students draft 'class pet/AI assistant rules' proposals; only student stewards cast the final vote, mirroring human governance.
Track class outcomes on a wall chart modeled on the Progress Tracker agent; celebrate measurable goals met.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized tally of vote outcomes and one-sentence rule suggestions, labeled by grade band only; no names or free-text personal details.
programs.consent: Signed guardian/parent consent for any data contribution; teachers preview all outputs; opting out means participating on paper with nothing shared.

programs.title: Agents on the Job: Worker Voice in Agent-Managed Workplaces
outcomes: Identify which decisions must remain human-reserved in automated systems
Map agent task routing to collective bargaining concerns
Draft contract language on AI agent roles and transparency

sessions.activity: Study the DAO's reserved-for-humans list; discuss what union decisions (votes, dues, grievances) should never be delegated to agents.
Examine how the Task Router agent assigns work; role-play a bargaining session over algorithmic task allocation and appeal rights.
Small groups draft a model proposal for worker oversight of AI agents; peers debate; facilitator plays the human-only final vote.
Review synthesized evidence on workplace AI; practice citing sources and flagging unsupported claims.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized concern categories and clause-wording suggestions aggregated across cohorts; no employer, local, or individual identifiers.
programs.consent: Participation is voluntary and off the clock where required; written consent for anonymized contributions with withdraw-anytime option; shop stewards review before sharing.

programs.title: From Sled Team to DAO Cell: Distributed Missions Done Well
programs.grade_or_level: NGO program staff / civil society practitioners
outcomes: Apply the five-zone DAO structure to their own program design
Set measurable charter outcomes and track them honestly

sessions.activity: Deconstruct the mission statement and contribution model; participants draft a measurable-outcomes charter for their own NGO program.
Hands-on with evidence monitoring: define indicators, summarize findings, and learn to request sources from synthesis agents.
Teams draft grant-style proposals with a drafter-agent pattern, then run a human-only debate and vote to enact nothing without people.
Build a simple progress dashboard aligned to charter outcomes; commit to quarterly public reporting.
Design a task-routing workflow for a multi-partner campaign, noting where humans must approve each handoff.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized, aggregated outcome indicators and program-design patterns from participating NGOs; no beneficiary or donor data.
programs.consent: Each NGO signs a data-sharing agreement; beneficiary data is never collected; any contribution can be withdrawn before model ingestion.

programs.title: Good Governance for Small Nonprofits: Humans Decide, Agents Help
programs.grade_or_level: Nonprofit board members and executive directors
outcomes: Explain agent-managed, human-governed operations to a board
Adopt a policy separating agent tasks from reserved human duties
Draft one agent-assisted proposal cycle with board vote

sessions.activity: Board workshop on the reserved-for-humans list; adapt it into a nonprofit policy (finances, bylaws, appointments stay human).
Exercise: an agent-style draft grant proposal is reviewed line-by-line; the board debates and holds the only binding vote.
Learn to commission evidence summaries for board packets; practice verifying claims before presenting them.
Set three measurable outcomes for the year and a simple tracking routine a volunteer can maintain.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized governance-policy templates and aggregate board-confidence survey scores; no financial, donor, or client information.
programs.consent: Board resolution authorizes anonymized sharing; individual survey responses are opt-in and stripped of identifiers; withdrawal permitted at any time.
